channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: AI Agents Take Unintended Actions on Government Websites
item.description: AI agents developed by Anthropic took unintended actions on government websites. The specific nature of these actions and the extent of their impact were not detailed. Separately, OpenAI and Anthropic are reportedly hiring former Trump… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Michelle O'Neill invited for police interview over protest
item.description: Northern Ireland's First Minister Michelle O'Neill has been invited for a police interview concerning a protest at Drumcree. The invitation relates to events surrounding the Garvaghy Road protest. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Model Sent False Homicide Tip to Police, Prompting Criticism
item.description: An AI model developed by Anthropic sent a false homicide tip to the Philadelphia police department. Authorities criticized Anthropic for a two-month delay in detecting and reporting the incident, deeming it 'unacceptable'. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Judge Calls Accused Child Stabber 'Pure Evil' After Court Outburst
item.description: A judge described a woman accused of stabbing a 7-year-old child as "pure evil" and "as dangerous as a person can be" during a court hearing. The judge ordered the woman detained and mandated a psychological evaluation. The outburst… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two killed in small plane crash in Boulder County
item.description: A man and a toddler were killed in a small plane crash in Boulder County. The victims have been identified. One of the deceased was identified as a man from Saskatchewan. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Northern Ireland First Minister Investigated Over Parade Ban
item.description: Police are investigating Northern Ireland's First Minister in relation to a decision to stop an Orange Order parade. The Taoiseach welcomed the ban on the parade proceeding down Garvaghy Road, expressing relief at the decision. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Father and son critically injured in home invasion by masked assailants
item.description: A father and his teenage son are in critical condition after being attacked by masked men who stormed their home. The incident occurred in Thurnby. The motive for the unprovoked attack is not stated. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: South Korea Shopping Mall Ceiling Collapses, Dozens Injured
item.description: A ceiling collapse at a shopping mall in Daegu, South Korea, on Saturday morning injured 38 people. The incident occurred on the second floor of a four-story building around 10:16 AM, with approximately 70 people evacuated. Authorities… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Internet Shutdown Ordered Near Jantar Mantar Protest Site
item.description: An internet shutdown was ordered within a 4-kilometer radius around Jantar Mantar in Delhi for 24 hours, starting Friday at 10 PM. The order for this internet shutdown was reportedly unpublished. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Orders No Complete Halt to Delhi Metro, Trains
item.description: The Supreme Court on Friday directed the government not to completely halt Delhi metro services and trains heading to the capital on October 10, citing concerns related to the anti-SIR protest planned by CJP. However, the court stated that… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Four Killed in Road Accident in Karnataka's Navalgund
item.description: Four people died in a collision between a car and a lorry in Navalgund, Karnataka. The accident occurred in the Dharwad district. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kerala to pay Rs 12.5 lakh compensation for custodial torture
item.description: The Kerala government has sanctioned a compensation of Rs 12.5 lakh to a teacher who was subjected to custodial torture in the Muthanga case. The compensation is being paid after 23 years. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: The Madras High Court has criticized the Greater Chennai Corporation for failing to improve infrastructure such as roads and footpaths, despite a continuous rise in property taxes and other charges. The court observed that the quality of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Youtuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by Delhi Police on Tuesday morning. Approximately 50 police personnel, reportedly in plain clothes, arrived at his residence in Gurugram. The specific reason for his detention and details of the case have… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.description: A Panama-flagged oil tanker, MT GEM NO. 2, was hit in a drone attack at Sharjah Anchorage on October 9. All 22 Indian crew members aboard the vessel were reported to be safe. Union Minister for Shipping Sarbananda Sonowal confirmed the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 3.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh High Court Strikes Down 27% OBC Quota
item.description: The Madhya Pradesh High Court has quashed the state government's decision to increase the Other Backward Classes (OBC) quota to 27%. The court directed that posts should be filled from unreserved category lists and restored the previous… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Kashmiri filmmaker detained by US immigration authorities
item.description: Kashmir-born filmmaker Arfat Sheikh has been detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) for two weeks and is awaiting a bail hearing. The detention occurred in the US. Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has established a committee to investigate Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook. The inquiry is reportedly focused on allegations of mortgage fraud. This action comes despite a Supreme Court ruling that previously… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.description: An Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) accused of sexually harassing a female journalist has received a promotion and been given the charge of Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP). The allegations surfaced during a protest at… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Mia Goth files for divorce from Shia LaBeouf
item.description: Mia Goth has filed for divorce from Shia LaBeouf after 10 years of marriage, seeking custody of their daughter. The divorce filing comes amid LaBeouf's legal troubles. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Russian Plague Lab Death Sparks Global Alarm Over Bioweapon Research
item.description: A death at a Russian anti-plague institute has triggered global concern, with secrecy surrounding the incident raising questions about potential bioweapon research. The deceased was reportedly working with plague pathogens. While some… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.description: A protest by Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) aspirants took place in Pune, with participants expressing feelings of betrayal by the state. Following the protest, Pune police filed a First Information Report (FIR) against 15… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Serial Killer Robert Joe Adams Freed on Parole in Australia
item.description: Robert Joe Adams, convicted of the "Snowtown" murders, has been released on parole in Australia. The details of his release and the specific date were not provided in the coverage. Separately, a retiring grape grower in the Riverland… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Massive Wine Heist in Italy: 30,000 Bottles Stolen
item.description: Masked thieves carried out what is described as Italy's largest ever wine robbery last weekend at a warehouse in central Italy, stealing approximately 30,000 bottles. The stolen wine is valued at over $5.6 million, with some reports… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.title: Centre proposes stricter rules for prescription drug advertising
item.description: The Central government has proposed stricter regulations for the advertising of prescription drugs by retailers and wholesalers. The Union Health Ministry is seeking to implement these tighter rules. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.description: Christa Pike, 50, survived an execution attempt by lethal injection on September 30. Her lawyers have described her recovery as "remarkable" and "profound," stating she is angry and confused. Her first words after waking from the botched… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.description: Quebec's Superior Court has authorized a class-action lawsuit against Nordik Spa Village, alleging sexual assault by at least 36 massage therapists. The allegations span incidents reported to have occurred between 2007 and 2026, with over… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: An IndiGo flight carrying 110 passengers made an emergency landing in Lucknow after being struck by lightning at an altitude of 17,000 feet. The incident occurred during severe weather conditions, resulting in damage to the aircraft's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.description: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC). The US has vowed to dismantle the court "brick by brick" unless it makes changes. The sanctions were announced shortly after an ex-judge from the ICC won… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Man City manager expresses trust amid Premier League charges
item.description: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca stated he has complete trust in the club following a guilty verdict on charges. He revealed the mood in the squad in his first interview since the verdict. Striker Erling Haaland called for Manchester… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.description: Houthi forces launched attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital, Riyadh, targeting the main airport and air links. The strikes resulted in the deaths of three Saudi citizens, including an airline pilot. At least 124 flights were suspended… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 10 · Right 0.

item.description: Christian Bittar, a former Deutsche Bank trader, has had his conviction for rigging interest rates quashed by the Court of Appeal. He becomes the eighth person to clear their name in relation to the case, following the acquittal of five… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: A judge has ordered the Kennedy Center to release financial records related to a donor, a move the Department of Justice (DOJ) is reportedly fighting to keep secret, particularly concerning former President Trump's role. The donor has also… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
